takeaways.text: Lines up **Slot** on **72%** of 243 plays (n=174); also Wide (outside) 23% (n=56).
Route on **98%** / blocks on **2%** of dropbacks (95% CI 95–99%, n=243) — 12 pts above the TE average of 86%.
On routes, averages **9.3 yd** downfield by the throw vs 8.2 for TEs (deeper) (n=237, snap→release window only).

Because he releases into a route on ~98% of dropbacks and most often from Slot, a coach might account for him as a receiver there rather than expecting help in protection — to be validated against film and matchup.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (8.7 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
